default.speaker: OLD MAN ELAM
default.text: AH... A TUNER. I HAVEN'T SEEN ONE IN YEARS. THE STILLNESS TOOK MOST OF YOUR KIND.

default.speaker: OLD MAN ELAM
default.text: LISTEN CAREFULLY. THE GREAT TUNING FORK IN THE NORTH DUNGEON HAS GONE SILENT. WITHOUT ITS RESONANCE... EVERYTHING FADES.

default.speaker: OLD MAN ELAM
default.text: YOU WILL NEED THE ECHO. A BOOMERANG THAT CAN AWAKEN THE SOUND-CRYSTALS. FIND IT IN THE EASTERN RUINS.

default.speaker: OLD MAN ELAM
default.text: BE CAREFUL, MEHDI. THE BAMBOOS WERE ONCE PEOPLE. THE STILLNESS HOLLOWED THEM OUT. THEY FEEL NOTHING NOW.

quest_complete.speaker: OLD MAN ELAM
quest_complete.text: YOU FOUND THE ECHO! GOOD. NOW STRIKE THE SOUND-CRYSTALS AND FOLLOW THE RESONANCE TO THE NORTH DUNGEON.

quest_complete.speaker: OLD MAN ELAM
quest_complete.text: THE RACCOON GUARDIAN BLOCKS THE PATH. IT WAS ONCE A PROTECTOR... NOW IT SERVES THE STILLNESS.

default.speaker: SILENT GUARD
default.text: BRING... THE ECHO... ONLY ITS RESONANCE... CAN OPEN... THIS GATE...

quest_complete.speaker: SILENT GUARD
quest_complete.text: THE PATH... OPENS... GO... BEFORE THE STILLNESS... TAKES ME TOO...

default.text: HEY! HEY YOU! DONT EVEN THINK ABOUT IT!

default.speaker: THE POT
default.text: I SAW WHAT YOU DID TO MY COUSINS IN THE OTHER ROOM. SAVAGES. ALL OF YOU TUNERS ARE THE SAME.

default.speaker: THE POT
default.text: JUST WALK AWAY. THERE IS NOTHING INSIDE ME. DEFINITELY NOT A HEART. NOPE. NOTHING.

quest_complete.speaker: THE POT
quest_complete.text: OH GREAT. YOURE BACK. LISTEN, I HEARD YOU BEAT THE RACCOON. VERY IMPRESSIVE.

quest_complete.speaker: THE POT
quest_complete.text: FINE. TAKE WHAT IS INSIDE ME. BUT KNOW THAT I WILL HAUNT YOUR INVENTORY FOREVER.
